messages:
rajesh: RCA published for the pruning rollout incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-6001
rajesh: Summary: an aggressive pruning recipe applied to a model variant reduced embedding vector magnitude for some tokens, causing similarity scores to shift and increasing false negatives for semantic search. Impact about ~35m during rollout; ~5% of queries degraded.
aline: Immediate mitigation was reverting the pruned artifact and pausing the rollout. We also re-ran a batch backfill for affected caches.
rajesh: Key action items we agreed on during the bridge:
- P1: Add embedding magnitude regression tests to model CI (owner: aline)
- P2: Bake artifact provenance and checksums into rollout manifests (owner: pete)
- P3: Add a canary smoke test that measures median similarity on canaries before cutover (owner: aline)
- P4: Create a customer outreach template and support list (owner: ops-bot)
- P5: Document safe pruning guidelines and default pruning thresholds (owner: pete)
pete: I'll take P2 and P5. ETA for manifests: 2025-06-02; docs ETA: 2025-06-05.
aline: Taking P1 & P3. I'll add a quick end-to-end that validates embedding norms and a canary metric check. ETA: PRs by Monday.
ops-bot: P4 template uploaded to RCA and linked. Support to coordinate sends after PRs land.
incident-bot: RCA RC-6001 created by rajesh. Title: "Pruning-induced embedding magnitude shift -> similarity regressions" https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-6001
rajesh: Checkpoints: 1-week sync 2025-06-09 09:00 PT, 30-day review 2025-07-08 09:00 PT. Calendar invites will be sent.
pete: I'll post PR links here as they land so we can track closure in the RCA.
aline: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/210 (embedding magnitude tests)
pete: Manifest checksum PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/artifacts/pull/102 (WIP)
ops-bot: Backfill status: completed for affected pools; logs attached in RCA.
rajesh: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene at the 1-week checkpoint to verify tests and close action items. Post blockers here or DM me. :white_check_mark:
